exercise.title: Raise a number to a power
exercise.statement: Write raise_to_power(base_num, pow_num) using a loop instead of **.

submissions.code:
def raise_to_power(base_num, pow_num):
    result = 1
    i = 0
    while i < pow_num:
        result = result * base_num
        i += 1
    return result

submissions.description: Adds instead of multiplying; computes base * pow instead of base ** pow
Starts with base_num instead of 1, multiplies one extra time
Initializes accumulator to 0 instead of 1; 0 * anything = 0
Prints instead of returning the result
